fields.title: A frame measurement counts only when the display was on
fields.description: Scripts only, package unchanged. A blank-window probe before and after every frame-sensitive session makes a sleeping panel invalid rather than failed, and the D5 check gains a long-frame row. Lands before the next frame-sensitive session counts.
